title: SiMa.ai raises $150 million in Series C to scale Physical AI
key_facts: SiMa.ai announced $150 million in Series C financing, bringing total capital raised to $500 million, at a valuation of $1.45 billion.
The San Jose, California start-up was co-led by Fidelity Management & Research Company and Amplify; Dell Technologies Capital, Maverick Capital, Point72 and others took part.
SiMa.ai sells a 'full-stack Physical AI platform' combining purpose-built silicon and software, the company says.
CEO Krishna Rangasayee called physical AI in humanoids, automotive and drones 'the gateway to a $50 trillion market'.
The money will go to Palette Neat, an agentic software environment, and next-generation chips with 1,000 dense TOPS of compute, per the press release.
quote_evidence: SiMa.ai has announced USD 150 million in Series C financing, bringing the total capital raised to USD 500 million and valuing the San Jose, California-based startup at USD 1.45 billion.

This capital raise will accelerate the scaling of Palette Neat, an agentic software environment for Physical AI, and fund next-generation hardware that will deliver 1,000 dense TOPS of compute in purpose-built Physical AI silicon, the press release said.
why_it_matters_hint: Investors are funding chips that run AI inside robots, cars and drones.
notes: Market-size and leadership claims are company and investor statements.
